global: This shoyu ramen features a clear, amber broth cradling noodles, topped with nori, chashu, menma, and naruto fish cake. Served in a blue-patterned bowl, it rests on a wooden table under warm, natural light.

regions.background: Wooden table surface shows light brown grain patterns and subtle texture under even lighting.
regions.bowl: The ceramic bowl has a white interior, blue patterned rim, and glossy finish with intricate wavy line designs.
regions.soup: The shoyu (soy sauce) broth is amber-colored, translucent, and gently swirling around thin noodles and garnishes.
regions.seaweed: Dark, irregularly shaped nori seaweed with a slightly glossy, textured surface and visible white salt crystals.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slice shows tender, glistening, light brown meat with a slightly uneven, moist surface and soft, yielding texture.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, fibrous, and slightly curled with visible texture and natural ridges.
regions.naruto: Naruto fish cake: pale pinkish-white, smooth, round, with subtle translucent sheen and faint surface texture.
